title: 形はなくとも手を伸ばす

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Pant, pant!
choice_data_list: Zephyr! Let's hit the incline one more time!
Zephyr! Let's hit the incline one more time!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Haaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With the Sprinters Stakes fast approaching, Yamanin Zephyr is putting everything she has into her daily training.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Though she almost despaired when faced with such formidable opponents, now it looks like awareness of the obstacles ahead has only heightened her motivation.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One of those opponents, Daiichi Ruby, has officially announced that she'll be competing in the upcoming Sprinters Stakes. However…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Given Yamanin Zephyr's current momentum, she'll undoubtedly be able to hold her own even against the senior runners.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But then…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Oh?

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: I repeat, according to the official announcement made at her press conference minutes ago…

text_block_list.name: TV
text_block_list.text: Tokai Teio, the undefeated Double Crown champion, will be skipping the Kikuka Sho to focus on recovering from an injury.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: "Tokai Teio to withdraw from Kikuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The news spreads almost instantaneously, triggering a secondary wave of despair among fans.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Unsurprisingly, that wave reaches Yamanin Zephyr as well…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I always felt that Teio and I were kindred spirits. Although the objects of our admiration were different, we both looked up to our own "emperor."

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Which is why… my legs tremble at the mere thought…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Just imagining the pain Teio must be feeling… watching as the dream she's chasing vanishes over the horizon…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr's clenched fists tremble ever so slightly. Although she looks as though she might collapse at any moment…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She also looks like she wants to sprint off as soon as she possibly can.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
choice_data_list: Do you want to cheer Teio up?
Do you want to cheer Teio up?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …If there's something I can do to help, then yes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But what could I even say to someone who's fallen into so dark an abyss?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Surely… there's nothing anyone could do?
choice_data_list: I don't think that's the case.
I don't think that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Why do you say that?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …I was?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I nod, then continue. I have absolutely no doubt that there's something we can do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thinking back to before summer camp…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Yamanin Zephyr had lost confidence in the face of such tough senior-year opponents… but Tokai Teio brought her courage back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The circumstances may be vastly different… and maybe the severity of the situation is too, but…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …Yes?
choice_data_list: You can change things by forming a connection.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: A connection…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They're both in the same generation, so when Yamanin Zephyr ran in Tokai Teio's slipstream, her momentum increased dramatically.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even with their roles reversed, the same principle is bound to hold true.
choice_data_list: And besides, you don't even have to say anything.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …But how can I help without saying a word?
choice_data_list: There's a way to convey your feelings—one that's unique to you guys.
There's a way to convey your feelings—one that's unique to you guys.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (A way only we can convey our feelings…)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: And with that, Yamanin Zephyr suddenly dashes out of the room.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She runs fast—as fast as the wind—to her injured friend's side.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Haha. Sighhh.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: The sky's… so far away.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …Zephyr?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Teio. Um, I…

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haha, I must look real uncool right now. Especially after I said all that stuff before summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I… can't move forward anymore.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I guess this means… my dream of becoming the undefeated Triple Crown champion is over.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: To be honest with you… I never even thought about it before.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: All I did was yearn. I did nothing but wish to become that wind I'd once seen…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I never once thought of trying to surpass the "Emperor" who inspired me or anything like that.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: But what you said… It was like you opened my eyes.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (Yes, this change, too… It must have been brought about by our connection—just as Trainer said.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (And if that's true… If we can do that…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So I… I will surpass my Emperor.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I will conquer both a sprint and a mile race.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And then… I'll go where not even the Mile Emperor could go and conquer a medium race as well.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: By becoming a triple-distance champion, I will become a peerless wind.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Zephyr…

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: And it all begins next week, at the Sprinters Stakes. I will show you the ferocity of my spirit.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: So, why not come and watch?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: …That's a low blow, you know that?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I mean, you're telling me you're gonna surpass your Emperor and you want me to come and watch you do it?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Even though that dream's out of my reach now?

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (There are no words. There's nothing else I can say here…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: …That's all I have to say.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you… at the Sprinters Stakes.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Sigh… Could've at least tried to comfort me.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: No "it's okay to just give up" or anything? I mean, come on.

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (There's a way to convey our feelings that's unique to us.)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: (For us…)

text_block_list.name: Yamanin Zephyr
text_block_list.text: Some feelings can only be conveyed through running.
